Resolves #5054

Tab containers now follow the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern:

- **Header:** the toolbar renders `role="tablist"`, plus `aria-orientation="vertical"` when docked left or right.
- **Tabs:** every tab states `aria-selected`, `"false"` included, and names its card in `aria-controls`. A new `cardId` config does this on both `tab.header.Button` and `tab.header.EffectButton`.
- **Cards:** each card becomes a `tabpanel` labelled by its tab, unless it already has its own role or accessible name. A grid card stays a grid, for example.

`tab.Container` keeps these links current when tabs are inserted or removed, and when a lazy card loads (on `cardLoaded`). A card removed without being destroyed loses only what the container set, so if it moves into another tab container, that container labels it. No code in `src/`, `apps/` or `examples/` set these attributes before, so there was no consumer code to delete.

Evidence: L2 (a unit spec on the VDOM, and a component spec in a real browser that queries the accessibility tree; both fail on `dev`) → L2 required (the outcome is the rendered DOM and nothing beyond it).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #5054.

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket body asks for `role`, `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`. `tablist`, `tabpanel`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-orientation` come from the premise read and the intake comment on #5054.
- Inactive tabs now carry `aria-selected="false"`; before, they had no attribute. With `removeInactiveCards` (the default), an inactive tab's `aria-controls` names a card that is not in the DOM until it is activated.
- Out of scope: the keyboard model (arrow keys, roving `tabindex`), which #5136 covers.
- Known residual: a header with actions (`headerActions`, or the dock's reveal overlay) places `button` children inside the `tablist`. Fixing that means restructuring the header DOM. Noted on #5054.

## Test Evidence
- Negative control: with `src/tab` at `dev` (`0091a91213`), `test/playwright/unit/tab/Aria.spec.mjs` fails 8 of 8, and `test/playwright/component/tab/Aria.spec.mjs` fails its first assertion: `getByRole('tablist').getByRole('tab')` finds 0 tabs where 2 are expected.
- Full unit suite at head: 5847 passed, 2 skipped. The tab component specs (`Aria`, `ContainerUi`, `OverflowAction`) pass 13 of 13.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here. The baseline unit and component specs ran.
